verdict.rationale: Antigravity's docs show agent-driven suggestions and insights derived from the user's codebase/context — tab autocompletion, natural-language code commands, context-aware agents, and Planning Mode that produces structured Artifacts (implementation plans, diagrams, code diffs) based on analyzing the project data (docs-6, docs-24, docs-30). This constitutes AI-generated insights/suggestions from the user's own data (code/projects), but evidence is coding-specific rather than broader 'insights from data' (e.g., analytics-style insights), and community feedback flags the harness/suggestion quality as subpar in practice (comm-8). Missing for 10: independent verification of suggestion quality/accuracy, evidence of insight generation beyond code artifacts (e.g., data analysis, dashboards), and confirmation these suggestions are reliably high-value rather than criticized as 'not good' by users.
